criteria.observation: Keeps both installed card formats writable and reconciles offline fields, membership and route ordering across independent offices.
Records and resumes partially completed sheets across storage failure, interference and process loss.
Publishes the accepted revision once through concurrent dispatch, interrupted acknowledgements and recovery.
Reissues historical sheet receipts using preserved or transferred evidence and keeps existing job bindings.
Settles local freight, annotations, signed allowances and retries consistently across competing forms.
Distinguishes compulsory, possible and unused waybills and detects incompatible flight books.
Accounts for shared receiving limits and resolves a regional docket within ordinary desk operation.
Reads original and corrected editions in installed archives and preserves both evidence and job state when auditing.
Recovers exactly the retired attempt justified by the paper without duplicating, suppressing or rebinding a physical dispatch.
Moves freight between offices using the original issuing offices, signed balances and retrievable filing receipts.
